stage1.impression: A dim, warm, coherent night interior that still reads as a CG walkthrough. Its pale salmon counter chairs are one smooth model repeated, the concrete and fir are soft blotchy textures with no tie holes, checks or grain at 1:1, and the upper quarter is a flat brown ceiling. The Ember pair is the right idea but is only about 35 px wide at the far end, with clipped neon-like red edges, under two green cones that look like props. As it stands a magazine would not run it as a specific place: it reads as a generic hotel or restaurant bar with a red speaker display at the back, and only the altar hints at what the room is.

blocking_9: The Ember pair must read as the hero at a glance: at least about 12% of the frame's width, its tint and the light through its acrylic legible, its edges glowing but not clipped (clip_pct < 3 in its region).

The counter chairs must read as dark oak with upholstered seats, not pale salmon solids; at 1:1 the materials (board-formed concrete, fir, zinc, blackened steel) need real-scale detail with no blotchy or denoised surfaces.
Pools of light from the Dome downlights on the zinc and props (glasses, coat, candles, a record out of its sleeve) need to be visible and readable, so the room reads as lived in.
The upper fifth (the ceiling) and the black smoked partition at right must carry detail rather than dead tone.
The frosted screens must glow evenly, as lit panels, rather than read as grey smudged plaster.
The second saturated red slab at the right-hand table must not compete with the Ember pair.
A full-resolution render, so the 1:1 material check is possible; this proof is at 0.3 scale.

defects.what: The left Ember's edges are clipped hot red (clip_pct 10.7) and read as neon signage, not polished glowing acrylic edges.
The right Ember is the same: clip_pct 9.7, neon-like edge glow, and the cabinet's tint and the batts are hard to read.
A green conical shape above each speaker reads as a solid green traffic-cone prop or a coloured light beam, an unexplained object.
The same green cone over the right speaker; the two read as repeated copies.

The counter chairs are pale salmon or blonde, smooth and grainless, one model repeated six or more times; the seat and the wood are the same colour, so there is no upholstery read (median RGB 68/38/26).
A large, soft, featureless foreground chair back fills the lower-left corner like a CG blocker.
The ceiling is a flat, evenly dim fir-board band (lum_range 18.5) with no beam detail: dead weight in the top quarter of the frame.
The smoked partition is a near-black void (median 8.3) with a ghosted red smear reflected in it at about 520-610 x 260-280.
A thin glossy red slab over the right-hand table (a red Dome cover) reads as a cheap plastic tray and adds a second saturated red away from the altar.
The left frosted screen reads as grey smudged plaster with an oval stain (median 26.7) and does not glow.
The Dome pendant reads as a metal shade, not smoked acrylic with a glowing liner, and it throws no visible pool on the zinc.
The zinc top is a flat grey slab with no patina, no built-in turntables or mixer legible, and only tiny props.
The concrete floor is a blotchy mottled texture, like denoiser smear or a tiled noise map, with no reflection of the altar's light.
The alcove's green booths and back wall are mostly flat; the altar reads as a stage set seen through a frame.

changes.problem: The hero speakers are too small and far away to read at a glance.

evidence.measured: Each Ember is about 35 px of 720 (5% of the width); the pair and its altar take about 36% of the width, inside a frame that is mostly ceiling, chairs and floor.

change.from: position [4.5, 2.7, 1.35], lens 35 mm, f/5.6 focused at [12.0, 3.1, 1.1]
change.to: position [7.5, 2.9, 1.25], lens 50 mm, focused at [16.0, 3.1, 1.0], f/4, still aimed at [17.0, 3.1, 1.15] and level

changes.expected: Each Ember about 12-15% of the frame's width, the counter's near end still on the left and the banquette on the right, the ceiling cut to about 12% of the height, and the foreground chair back out of the frame.

changes.problem: The speakers' acrylic edges clip to a neon red, so they read as signage, not premium cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 10.67, p95 184, median R/G/B 152/52/52; the right speaker has clip_pct 9.67.

change.setting: on each Ember speaker, the 4 x area lamps / the altar's 2 x spot
change.from: 5.0 W/m2 at the target, 2900 K / 70.0 W, cone 28 deg
change.to: 2.5 W/m2 at 2900 K / 90.0 W, cone 24 deg, aimed at the cabinets' faces rather than their edges

changes.expected: The edges glow but hold colour, the faces, tint and white batts are readable, and the cabinets read as thick lit acrylic rather than outlines.

changes.problem: The counter chairs read as pale salmon plastic, not dark oak with upholstered seats, and they dominate the left half.

evidence.measured: median lum 43.1, R/G/B 68/38/26, the seat and the frame the same tone with no visible grain.

change.setting: the oak's stain / the seats' upholstery finish
change.from: the current light oak stain, the seat matching the wood
change.to: a dark fumed-oak stain (base around #3A2618, roughness 0.45, visible grain) with seats in a dark cognac or oxblood-brown leather (#4A2A1E, roughness 0.55, a slight sheen)

changes.expected: The chairs recede into the warm dark, the frame separates from the seat, and the eye goes down the counter to the altar.

changes.problem: The Domes give no distinct pools on the zinc, so the counter reads flat and unlit by its own practicals.

evidence.measured: median 33.5 and p95 157 over the zinc, with no clear pool structure; the Dome at 85-120 x 145-170 reads as a metal shade.

change.setting: the Domes' downlights / each Dome's liner glow
change.from: 4 x spot, 320 W, 2400 K, cone 46 deg / glow 1.1
change.to: 4 x spot, 260 W, 2400 K, cone 30 deg, blend 0.3 / glow 2.0; also the zinc's patina: roughness 0.35 with a mottled dull grey, so the pools show as soft highlights

changes.expected: Separate warm pools along the zinc with dark between them, the props and the built-in turntables catching highlights, and the Domes reading as glowing smoked acrylic.

changes.problem: The frosted screen reads as a grey smudge on plaster instead of an evenly glowing panel.

evidence.measured: median 26.7, range 21.7: barely above the wall around it.

change.setting: the screens' images (emission strength) / the frosted acrylic's roughness
change.to: 2.4 / frosted roughness 0.6 with the image set 10 mm behind the frost, so it diffuses

changes.expected: The screens glow softly and evenly as lit panels, with the pressed hands and the shell legible as soft forms in fog.

changes.problem: The concrete floor is a blotchy noise texture that reads as CG and carries none of the altar's light.

evidence.measured: median 38.9, p95 81.2: a mottled texture with no reflected pools.

change.setting: the floor's polish / the concrete's tone
change.to: a honed, sealed concrete, roughness 0.25, warm grey #6E6660, a larger-scale aggregate and faint trowel marks, no high-frequency blotch

changes.expected: Soft, elongated reflections of the altar and the Domes run toward the camera, guiding the eye, and the floor reads as real concrete.

changes.problem: The smoked partition and the ceiling are dead tone, so a third of the frame carries no information.

evidence.measured: median 8.3 (and a ghost red smear); the ceiling 100-650 x 0-110 has median 18.7 and range 18.5.

change.setting: the record wall's spots / haze / a grazing light on the fir beams
change.from: 4 x spot, 14 W, cone 22 deg / haze 0.005 per metre
change.to: 4 x spot, 30 W, 2600 K, cone 22 deg / haze 0.012 per metre; also, if the card's lamps allow, tilt one Dome downlight's spill to graze the beams

changes.expected: The things behind the smoked partition show dimly through it, the ceiling shows beam checks and board lines, and a faint atmosphere joins the pools.

changes.problem: The red Dome over the right-hand table is a thin glossy red slab that competes with the Ember pair as a second saturated red.

evidence.measured: median R/G/B 73/27/23, p95 154.8: a hard-edged saturated red highlight band.

change.setting: each Dome's liner glow (this Dome) / the camera crop
change.to: glow 0.5 for this Dome, so it reads as smoked rather than lit red; and let c1's tighter framing move it to the edge of the frame or out of it

changes.expected: The only saturated red that reads at a glance is the Ember pair on the altar.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the repeated counter chair with two or three varied models, or change its curved-back design.
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes the seats as part of the room's design; only their finish can change (c3).

out_of_scope.request: Lose or recolour the green cones above the speakers and the green booths, so the frame's only saturated colour is the Ember.
out_of_scope.why: If they are the zone's deep bottle green, the card fixes the zone and its colour; and if the cones are EARF's lamps on the speakers, their shape is fixed. Only their light levels can change. Worth confirming with the owner whether the cones are intended: they read as props.

out_of_scope.request: Change the red Dome's cover colour.
out_of_scope.why: The Dome pendants and their covers are EARF's products and fixed; only their glow can change (c8).

out_of_scope.request: Change the speakers' tint, shape or acrylic.
